title: 求值顺序与寄存器压力 / Evaluation order and register pressure

checks.name: Sethi-Ullman order: correct result with 3 registers
left operand first: same result, 6 registers (right-deep e2 keeps every leaf live)
labels without the +1 on ties: ordering degenerates to left-first, 6 registers
side effect on the right: operands stay in source order, prints 17 (3 registers)
reordering across inc!: 2 registers but prints 18, miscompiled silently

left-first.reason: always generate the left operand first
left-first.explain: 总是先算左子树：右深的 e2 每进一层都要多占一个寄存器，6 个叶子同时活着。结果仍然正确，只是寄存器需求从 3 涨到 6。

smaller-first.reason: wrong heuristic: generate the operand that needs FEWER registers first
smaller-first.explain: 反着用 Sethi-Ullman：先算需求小的子树，它的结果要一直占着一个寄存器，等需求大的子树算完。

flat-labels.reason: wrong labelling: forget the +1 when both subtrees need the same number of registers
flat-labels.explain: 标号时漏了“两边需求相等要 +1”，所有结点的需求都成了 1，排序信息全丢了，退化成从左到右。

reorder-across-effects.reason: wrong: reorder operands even when one has a side effect
reorder-across-effects.explain: 右操作数 (* (inc! x) 2) 需要的寄存器更多，于是被提前算；inc! 先把 x 改成 6，左边再读 x 就成了 6。程序照常结束，打印 18 而不是 17。
